senses.definition: Unhappy because someone else has something that you would like to have.

examples.text: Ik ben jaloers op zijn nieuwe auto.
examples.translation: I am jealous of his new car.
examples.emotion: resentful and wishing you had that car yourself

senses.definition: Feeling unhappy and angry because someone you love seems too interested in someone else.

examples.text: Word niet zo jaloers als ik met haar praat.
examples.translation: Don't be so jealous when I talk to her.
examples.emotion: insecure and slightly defensive, wanting reassurance
